study_identification_part.si_4_title: Brain charts for the human lifespan

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: This study aggregated data from over 100 primary studies including: 3R-BRAIN, ABCD, ABIDE (I+II), ADHD-200, ADNI, AIBL, AOBA, AOMIC (ID1000, PIOP1, PIOP2), ARWiBo, ASRB, BabyConnectome, BGSP, BHRCS, BIODEP, BSNIP, Calgary, CALM, Cam-CAN, CAMFT, CHILD, COBRE, Conte, Cornell, CUBA, cVEDA, devCCNP, dHCP, DLBS, EDSD, EMBARC, FemaleASD, FinnBrain, Frankfurt, GOBS, GOSH, GUSTO, HABS, Harvard_Fetal (1-3), HBN, HCP, HCP_lifespanA, HCP_lifespanD, IBIS, ICBM, IMAGEN, IMAP, IXI, KNE96, LA5c, LATAM, LIFE, Maastricht, MCIC, MCSA, MRi-Share, Narratives, NHGRI, NIH, NIHPD, NKI, NSPN, NTB_Yale, OASIS3, OHSU_ADHD, OpenPain (multiple), Oslo, Oulu, PCDC, PING, Pixar, PNC, POND, PPMI, PREVENTAD, Psyscan_Dublin, RDB, SALD, SCZIowa, SLIM, STRIVE, SWU_MDD, SYS_Adolescents, SYS_Adults, TOPSY, UCSD, UK Biobank, VETSA, VITA, WAYNE, and others. Total: 123,984 scans from 101,457 participants across more than 100 primary studies.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "we aggregated 123,984 MRI scans, across more than 100 primary studies, from 101,457 human participants between 115 days post-conception to 100 years of age."

answer.MULTI-DATASET (UNSPECIFIED OR N>=10): normative model training/validation/testing and clinical case-control comparisons

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: All datasets were used to build reference brain charts using GAMLSS modelling. Healthy control subjects from each dataset were used to estimate normative trajectories for brain structural phenotypes (GMV, WMV, sGMV, ventricles, cortical thickness, surface area, regional volumes). Clinical subjects (with various diagnoses including ASD, ADHD, schizophrenia, Alzheimer's disease, MCI, depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder, etc.) were used for case-control comparisons against the normative centile scores. Cross-sectional data (~90%) was used for model estimation; longitudinal data (~10%) was used to assess stability of centile scores.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "GAMLSS models were fitted to structural MRI data from control subjects for the four main tissue volumes of the cerebrum"; "The clinical diversity of the aggregated dataset enabled us to comprehensively investigate case-control differences in individually specific centile scores across a range of conditions."

model-3.overall-phase: NR (similar scale, excluding infant FreeSurfer processed data)

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: The study built separate GAMLSS normative models for each MRI phenotype. The reference dataset comprised healthy control subjects from over 100 primary studies. From Supplementary Table 1.2, the GMV model included 77,157 control subjects (38,839 female, 38,318 male) from 100 unique studies. Similar sample sizes were used for other phenotypes with minor variations due to data availability and quality control. The study did not explicitly separate train vs. test phases; models were cross-validated using leave-one-study-out (LOSO) analyses. Total aggregate: 123,984 scans from 101,457 participants (controls + clinical cases combined).
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "GAMLSS models were fitted to structural MRI data from control subjects"; Supplementary Table 1.2 lists demographics per study for GMV model showing total N=77,157 across 100 studies.

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Ages are expressed in years. The study spans from mid-gestation (115 days post-conception = ~0.31 years) to 100 years of age. Weighted mean age calculated from Supplementary Table 1.2 data for GMV model is approximately 41.45 years. Age range is explicitly stated as '115 days post-conception to 100 years of age'. Ages in supplementary tables are provided in days; min=115 days (~0.31 years), max=36,504 days (~99.94 years). SD and other statistics not directly reported but age distributions shown in Fig. S17.2.
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: "from 101,457 human participants between 115 days post-conception to 100 years of age"; "Fig. S17.2. Histograms and probability density plots of age of participants in the reference database, stratified by sex."

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Sex information calculated from Supplementary Table 1.2 (Grey matter volume). Female: 38,839 (50.3%); Male: 38,318 (49.7%); Total: 77,157. The GAMLSS models were stratified by sex, following the approach of anthropometric growth charts. Similar proportions expected for other phenotypes.
dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: "a sex-stratified approach"; Supplementary Table 1.2 provides sample sizes per sex per study for GMV model.
